title: Report: Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson still weeks away from return from hamstring injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson still weeks away from return from hamstring injury
sources.description: The Saints will face the Falcons without first-round pick Jordyn Tyson on Monday night and it will reportedly be a little while longer before the wideout makes his NFL debut.
